snippet.title: Clomid : combien de cycles avant d'arrêter ?
snippet.description:
Combien de cycles de Clomid avant de changer de stratégie ? C'est l'une des questions les plus fréquentes en consultation — et la réponse dépend du profil de chaque patiente, de l'âge, du diagnostic initial, et du contexte du couple.

Le Dr Senai Aksoy, professeur associé (Doçent) de gynécologie-obstétrique et spécialiste en médecine de la reproduction, explique les seuils habituels, pourquoi poursuivre au-delà peut être contre-productif, et quelles sont les alternatives à envisager.

Chapitres :
0:00 Introduction
0:31 Le Clomid, comment ça marche ?
1:03 Pour qui ?
1:42 Combien de cycles essayer ?
2:52 Ce qui fait varier la décision : âge, ovaires, cause
3:41 Les chiffres : chances par cycle et cumulées
4:53 Quand changer de stratégie
5:31 Les alternatives : gonadotrophines, insémination, FIV
6:12 Ce que disent les recommandations
7:10 À retenir
7:41 Conclusion

RÉFÉRENCES
• ASRM. Use of clomiphene citrate in infertile women. Fertil Steril 2013 — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23809505/
• Teede HJ et al. Recommendations from the 2023 international evidence-based guideline for PCOS. J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2023 — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37580314/
• Franik S et al. Aromatase inhibitors (letrozole) for ovulation induction in PCOS. Cochrane 2022 — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36165742/

en.title: How many times do you have to use Clomid before stopping?
en.description:
🎉 Clomid hasn't given you the baby of your dreams yet? 🍼 No problem, we're here to talk about it! In this video, we decipher what you can do if that famous Clomid hasn't (yet) worked wonders. Should you try your luck again or explore new adventures in the world of fertility? 🌈

On the program:

🕵️ The secrets of Clomid: How does this little pill really work?
🔄 To try again or not?: How many times should you try before changing your plan?
📈 The numbers that count: Your real chances of getting pregnant on the first, third or fifth try!
🚀 The cool alternatives: Other options to boost your fertility!
Ready to turn this challenge into an adventure full of hope and smiles? Then let's go! 😄

Don't forget to subscribe to join our great community and make sure you don't miss any of our tips to help you realize your dream of parenthood! 💖

en-US.title: Clomid: How Many Cycles Before Stopping? Dr. Aksoy Answers Your Questions!
en-US.description:
In this essential video, Dr. Senai Aksoy, an infertility and IVF specialist, answers the question many people ask: How many times should you use Clomid before stopping? Discover the recommended cycles, success rates, and alternatives for your infertility treatment.

Clomid: Understanding Its Role in Infertility Treatment
Clomid is often the first step in stimulating ovulation. But how does it really work and who is it for? Dr. Aksoy explains everything.

Why are 3 to 6 cycles of Clomid recommended?
Fertility is a complex journey. Understand why doctors suggest a specific number of cycles to maximize your chances of getting pregnant with Clomid.

When should you consider stopping Clomid?
Your age, the cause of your infertility, your response to treatment, and your state of mind are key factors. Discover the signs that indicate it's time to discuss a new strategy with your doctor.

Clomid Success Rates: The Real Numbers
What are your chances of getting pregnant after 1, 3, or 6 cycles of Clomid? Dr. Aksoy shares the statistics to give you a clear perspective.

Alternatives to Clomid: What to Do If It Doesn't Work
If Clomid doesn't deliver the results you'd hoped for, other options are available. Learn about injectable gonadotropins, intrauterine insemination (IUI), and in vitro fertilization (IVF).

Fertility Experts' Take
What do major reproductive companies and scientific studies say about how long to use Clomid? Dr. Aksoy sheds light on current recommendations.

In Summary: Your Fertility Journey
Clomid is a tool, not a magic wand. Give it a chance, communicate with your doctor, and don't hesitate to explore other infertility treatments if necessary.

00:33 What is Clomid?
01:42 Treatment duration
02:08 How to take it?
03:41 Success rates
04:36 When to change strategies?
05:31 Other options
06:12 Expert advice
07:06 Summary
07:56 End
